app.name: RigelLedger
app.new_version: A new version of RigelLedger is available.

onboarding.title: Create your first book
onboarding.description: A book is one set of accounts in one base currency. You can share it with family later.
onboarding.base_currency_hint: Every amount is also kept in this currency. Reports use it.

overview.title: Overview
overview.empty: No transactions yet. Record one to see balances here.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.foreign_hint: Leave the charged amount as an estimate and fix it when the bank posts it.
transactions.base_hint: From the rate on this date; type the bank's figure to override.
transactions.rate_missing: No rate: enter the base amount
transactions.split_needed: This entry needs the split view.
transactions.cost_required: Enter the cost (0 for miles earned)
transactions.base_missing: Some lines have no base amount yet

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.name: Name
accounts.name_hint: Leave empty to use the default name.
accounts.opening_hint: What you have (asset) or owe (liability) on the date.

book.title: Book settings
book.name: Name
book.base_currency_hint: Fixed when the book is created; changing it later is an explicit rebase.
book.lock_date_hint: Nothing on or before this date can be changed.
book.cf_choice: Interest and dividends in cash flow
book.cf_choice_hint: IAS 7 allows either operating or investing.
book.rates_hint: 1 unit of the first currency = rate units of the second. Shared by every book.
book.commodities_hint: Shares and futures are priced in a quote currency. Miles and card points have no price: they are carried at what they cost. Shared by every book.
book.contract_size_hint: Futures only: units per contract (TX = 200). Shown as exposure, never as asset value.

settings.title: Settings
settings.display_currency_hint: Your preferred currency for totals. Changing it never changes stored amounts.
settings.password_changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

field.unpriced: Carried at cost; has no price
field.rate_missing: No rate for this date: enter the base amount

error.role: Your role in this book does not allow this
error.unbalanced: Debits and credits do not balance
error.book_locked: The book is locked for that date
error.last_owner: A book must keep at least one owner
error.system_account: This account is required by the book
error.has_postings: The account has transactions; archive it instead
error.has_children: Move or delete the sub-accounts first
error.transaction_balanced: Debits and credits do not balance
error.transaction_min_postings: A transaction needs at least two lines
error.posting_commodity: The currency does not match the account
error.posting_account_placeholder: A group account cannot hold transactions
error.posting_base_amount: Base amount must equal the amount in the base currency
error.invalid_reference: Something it refers to does not exist
error.onboarding_required: Finish setting up your account first
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again later.
error.pending_registration: A sign-up with this username or address is waiting for its confirmation
error.mail_failed: The email could not be sent. Check the mail settings.
error.already_initialized: Your account is already set up
error.last_admin: The last administrator cannot be removed
error.self: You cannot change your own account here
error.mfa_step_up: Sign in again with your second factor first
error.last_factor: Add another method before removing this one
error.method_disabled: The administrator has turned this method off
error.already_enrolled: Already set up; remove it first

profile.username_hint: Used to sign in: a-z, 0-9, dot, dash, underscore

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.description: Set up your account before you start. You can change all of this later in Settings.
welcome.password_intro: Your account was created with an initial password. Choose your own before continuing.
welcome.email_intro: Verify your email address: we send a 6-digit code to it.

email.enter_code: Enter the 6-digit code sent to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
email.change_hint: A new address takes effect once you enter the code sent to it. Your old address is told.

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.description: Choose your settings and a password for {email}.
invite.invalid: It was already used, withdrawn, or has expired. Ask your administrator for a new one.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: We send a link to confirm your address.
register.have_account: Already have an account? Sign in
register.check_mail_hint: Open the link we sent to {email} within 24 hours to finish signing up.

request.title: Request access
request.description: An administrator reviews your request and sends an invitation by email.
request.sent_hint: If it is approved you will receive an invitation by email.

security.sessions_hint: Sign out any device you do not recognise. Changing your password signs out all the others.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Users, invitations, sign-in rules, defaults and outgoing mail for everyone on this server.
admin.invite_hint: They receive a link to choose their settings and a password.
admin.deactivate_confirm: Deactivate this user? Their sessions end at once.
admin.requests_off: Access requests are off: choose "Request an invitation" under Sign-in & security.
admin.registration_hint: How new people get an account.
admin.registration_closed_hint: Only an administrator can add people, by inviting them.
admin.registration_request_hint: Anyone can ask; an administrator approves, which sends the invitation.
admin.registration_open_hint: Anyone can create an account after confirming their email address.
admin.mfa_hint: Enforced once two-factor sign-in ships (next release); until then these are saved but not applied.
admin.mfa_required: Every user must use a second factor
admin.sign_in_limits_hint: Failed sign-ins inside the window are counted per username and address, per address, and per username. Past a limit, sign-in is refused until the window passes.
admin.session_ttl_hint: Extended on every use. Empty: the server default.
admin.defaults_hint: What an invited or new user starts with; each can change their own later.
admin.mail_hint: Used for invitations, sign-up links and verification codes. The password is stored encrypted and never shown again.
admin.smtp_password_hint: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
admin.save_and_test: Save and send a test email
admin.test_logged: Mail is set to the server log: the test was written there and NOT sent. Choose SMTP and save.
admin.test_hint: The test uses the saved settings and goes to your own address.
admin.test_hint_log: Mail is not being sent yet: delivery is the server log until SMTP is saved.
admin.reset_mfa_confirm: Remove every second factor of this user and sign them out? They set it up again at the next sign-in.

mfa.title: Two-factor sign-in
mfa.settings_hint: A second proof on top of your password. Passkeys are the strongest and the easiest.
mfa.password_hint: Needed to remove a method or to make new recovery codes.
mfa.second_step: One more step: prove it is you
mfa.totp_hint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app
mfa.email_hint: We can mail a code to your address.
mfa.email_sent: A code is on its way. It expires in 10 minutes.
mfa.passkey_hint: Use the passkey saved on this device, your phone or a security key.
mfa.setup_description: This server requires a second proof on top of your password. Choose one; you can add more later in Settings.
mfa.totp_setup_hint: Scan the QR code with an app such as Google Authenticator, 1Password or Aegis, then enter a code.
mfa.qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.email_setup_hint: Codes go to {email}. Weaker than the others: anyone in that mailbox gets in.
mfa.passkey_setup_hint: Saved in this device, your phone or a security key, unlocked with your fingerprint, face or PIN. Works alone: no password needed.
mfa.passkey_unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
mfa.codes_hint: Each works once, if you lose your other methods. They are shown only now: store them in your password manager.
mfa.codes_regenerated: New recovery codes; the old ones no longer work
mfa.alerts: Email me when someone signs in from a new address
